name: Modern Pig 84
author: Codecite
description: Gradient rounded red button that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateY(3px), box-shadow becomes none.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Modern Pig 84</title>
<style>
/* Modern Pig 84 by Codecite — https://uiverse.io/Codecite/modern-pig-84 */
.btn {
  transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
  font-family: "Dosis", sans-serif;
}

.btn {
  width: 150px;
  height: 60px;
  border-radius: 50px;
  background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #feb692 0%, #ea5455 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 30px -6px rgba(238, 103, 97, 0.5);
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  font-size: 24px;
  color: white;
}

.btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(3px);
  box-shadow: none;
}

.btn:active {
  opacity: 0.5;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="btn">Hover</button>

</body>
</html>
